name: Socata TB 20/21 Trinidad
summary: French four-seat, low-wing, retractable-gear tourer related to the fixed-gear TB 9/10; a fast, well-built type common in Europe and Canada but uncommon in the US.

engines: Single Lycoming flat-six in a smooth, rounded cowl
fuselage: Roomy four-seat cabin with a wide windshield
tail: Swept fin with a rounded tip
Horizontal tail set low on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Low-wing four-seater with retractable tricycle gear and a rounded cabin
Smooth rounded cowl with a constant-speed prop
Swept fin on a conventional tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The TB 20 has a rounder, wider cabin with a large wraparound windshield; the PA-28 has a narrower, boxier cabin and an all-flying stabilator.
The TB 20 has a swept-back fin and a wide cabin; the Mooney has a forward-swept fin and a narrow cabin.
The TB 20 has a swept fin and a smaller cabin; the A36 has a bigger cabin with rear cargo doors.
The TB 20 is all-metal with retractable gear; the SR series is composite with fixed gear and a parachute hatch on the rear deck.
